# BLAKE3 1.8.7

These are the portable C implementation, headers and licenses from the official
[`blake3` 1.8.7 crate](https://crates.io/crates/blake3/1.8.7), upstream commit
[`f3149ec5bb5449af877ba20377a11008ff499fa2`](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3/tree/f3149ec5bb5449af877ba20377a11008ff499fa2).
The archive SHA-256 is
`6d9e454fc11f76977dc803893aff6304ed33d6a26efae8696573bea74baa27ae`.
Forge compiles these sources as C with SIMD backends disabled.
